build.fast_path: Fast path (kit shown at the Nov 6 broadcast; final numbers land at launch): Lullaby + a 5-piece set in a 43311 layout — Flower of Tinged Yearning with Formrender for Unison teams, Rejuvenating Glow with Fallacy of No Return for Echo teams. Aim for a Healing Bonus 4-cost, Energy Regen 3-costs, HP% 1-costs, and 260% Energy Regen. Skill priority: Forte > Liberation > Intro > Basic ATK > Skill. Support rotation: Intro > Skill > BA1-4 > Forte > Liberation > Outro; hold Forte until Finale, use Echo before switching.

profile.role_note: Support and healer. She heals the team, deals AoE damage, gathers enemies while channeling her Forte, and keeps healing through her Resonance Liberation. Her buffs apply in Unison and Echo teams; Lullaby’s buffs do not apply outside them. Kit shown at the Nov 6 preview broadcast; final numbers land at launch on Nov 12, 2026.

pull_verdict.source_guide: Huaxu Academy Lily Complete Guide infographic (Beta v3.8.1), supplied by Tom 2026-10-26
pull_verdict.verdict: Kit revealed at the Nov 6 preview broadcast: Spectro Pistols support whose buffs shine in Unison and Echo teams. She launches Nov 12, 2026 in 3.8 Phase 1, alongside Sigrika and Qiuyuan reruns (4-star rate-ups: Youhu, Aalto, Yangyang), with her signature Lullaby on the weapon banner. From beta coverage (single infographic source): S2 is the breakpoint for universal support, and S2R0 is comparable to S2R1 Shorekeeper — she does not need her signature weapon for universal use. Final numbers lock at launch, so treat the sequence details as pre-launch until Nov 12.

sequences.weapon_vs_dupes: Dupes before signature for universal use: S2R0 is comparable to S2R1 Shorekeeper, so chase S2 before the signature weapon (Beta).

teams_meta.note: Beta synergies — Primary: Hsin, Suoming, Sigrika, Lucilla. Secondary: Galbrena, Jinhsi. Almost no synergy: Phrolova (all of Lily's Echo buffs apply only to the active Resonator) and Qiuyuan S3+ (an Echo/Heavy hybrid; in Lily's Echo mode he mainly benefits from the Liberation buff). Galbrena benefits more from Lily than Qiuyuan does. Support packages (Beta): Echo S0R1: 25% AMP, 39% ATK, 10% CR, 20% CD, 24% ES Bonus; Echo S2R1: 25% AMP, 53% ATK, 18% CR, 44% CD, 24% ES Bonus; Unison S0R1: 25% AMP, 90% ATK (S6 Hsin 97%); Unison S2R1: 25% AMP, 90% ATK, 8% CR, 24% CD; General S0R0: 25% AMP, 39% ATK; General S2R0: 25% AMP, 53% ATK, 8% CR, 24% CD; S2R0 SK: 15% AMP, 65% ATK, 12.5% CR, 25% CD. AMP = damage amplification; ES = Echo Skill; SK = Shorekeeper. No full three-member teams are confirmed in the Beta source.
